claim: No sector may be lit without a visible source of that light, and a lamp that blinks, goes out or travels must change every sector it lights, not only its own.
evidence: The owner, 2026-11-24: 'there are light sectors withou apparent source of light, when you made light blinking it should also affect neighbouring sectors that are lit by that light'.
use: Hang lamps and let the light stage trace them rather than painting pools; a lamp that switches is a LampGroup and switch_lamps gives all its sectors the same wave and wire. A sector that transmits (a secret) cannot take a lamp's rx, since an object has one rx and one tx.
